verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several built-in AI features that take on delegated work. These include AI Close agents that reconcile accounts and review transactions, an in-app "ask AI" button for categorization, Accounting AI prompts run against the general ledger, AI tasks such as cash forecasting, and busywork that is "described once, done automatically, reviewed by you." The MCP connection to Claude is an external assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-product assistant's task scope and delegation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.

Hand off the busywork. Finding software subscriptions, matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
You can see runway on the Dashboard, run a forecast as an AI task
